title: Getting Out of the Way and Letting God Speak
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the secret to a life of peace and guidance, one that requires humility and trust in God's presence. By shutting out distractions and focusing on the stillness, you can experience a deeper connection with God and receive the clarity and direction you need to navigate life's challenges. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the simple yet profound truth that can transform your life and help you live with confidence and purpose.
